products.name: AI网络全栈组合（硅、系统、软件）
products.description: 通过统一的开放标准AI架构，将加速器、内存和存储连接成单一高性能AI引擎，专为消除大规模同步AI工作负载（包括前沿模型的训练和推理）中的网络瓶颈而构建。
products.target_customers: 超大规模云服务商和领先的新云基础设施提供商
features: 全栈组合涵盖硅、系统和软件
消除大规模同步AI工作负载的网络瓶颈

evidence_refs.quote: Upscale AI is reimagining networking for the AI era with a full-stack portfolio spanning silicon, systems, and software. Through a unified, open-standard AI fabric, the company connects accelerators, memory, and storage into a single high-performance AI engine purpose-built to eliminate network bottlenecks across large-scale, synchronized AI workloads, including training and inference of frontier models.

products.name: SkyHammer芯片（Scale-up交换机）
products.description: 提供确定性延迟的定制芯片，支持UALink和ESUN等开放协议，使GPU能像访问本地内存一样读取彼此的内存，避免数据移动速度的意外停顿。

evidence_refs.quote: Upscale says its scale-up line delivers what it calls deterministic latency, meaning data-movement speeds can be known in advance and unexpected stalls avoided. The capability runs on a custom chip the company calls SkyHammer, which supports open protocols built for this kind of traffic, including UALink, a standard that lets GPUs read one another's memory as if it were local, and ESUN, an AI-tuned flavor of Ethernet.

products.name: 基于NVIDIA Spectrum-X的Scale-out交换机
products.description: 基于NVIDIA Spectrum-X硅构建的交换机产品线，搭配AI优化版SONiC网络操作系统，旨在简化运行。

evidence_refs.quote: On the scale-out side, Upscale is leaning directly on Nvidia. In March it previewed a switch line built around Nvidia's Spectrum-X silicon, paired with SONiC, an open-source network operating system Microsoft originally created for its own cloud. Upscale has built an AI-tuned version of SONiC meant to make the notoriously fiddly software easier to run.

evidence_refs.quote: Nvidia sells its own Spectrum-X switches.
Upscale is betting that an AI-only design built on open standards can win business from buyers wary of being locked into a single vendor.

quotes.speaker: Barun Kar
quotes.quote: AI infrastructure is being redefined at cluster scale, and networking is one of the most critical bottlenecks. Upscale AI is building a high-performance, open-standard AI fabric purpose-built for large-scale, synchronized workloads. This investment reinforces our vision and enables us to scale the business as we engage with leading neocloud and hyperscale infrastructure providers to meet growing demand for open, interoperable AI infrastructure.

investment_rationale.speaker: Sandesh Patnam
investment_rationale.rationale: 看好Upscale AI团队解决AI基础设施中最关键的网络瓶颈，采用差异化的架构方法，自初始投资以来进展加深了其信心，因此决定领投本轮。
investment_rationale.quote: Rajiv, Barun, and the Upscale AI team are tackling one of the most critical bottlenecks in AI infrastructure, and they're doing it with a world-class team and a differentiated architectural approach. The progress we've seen since our initial investment has only deepened our conviction, and we're thrilled to lead this round and double down on the company's vision.

investment_rationale.speaker: Navin Chaddha
investment_rationale.rationale: 认为AI性能的下一次飞跃在于连接计算、内存和存储的网络层，Upscale AI以开放标准、全栈方法重新构想AI网络，使加速器、内存和存储同步运行，并看重创始团队。
investment_rationale.quote: The next leap in AI performance will be won in the networking that ties compute, memory, and storage together. What excites us is how Upscale AI is reimagining AI networking with an open-standard, full-stack approach that gets accelerators, memory, and storage operating in lockstep. At Mayfield, we invest in people first, and we're proud to partner with Barun and Rajiv as they build an enduring company powering the era of frontier AI.

analysis.capital_judgment: 资本押注的核心变量是AI基础设施价值从计算层向网络层的迁移。Upscale AI在成立约一年内以$2B估值完成$500M总融资，估值建立在其创始团队深厚的网络芯片背景（来自Innovium、Cavium、Intel、Palo Alto Networks等）、NVIDIA作为战略投资者的背书、以及多家超大规模云服务商和新云提供商正在进行产品评估的早期商业验证之上。然而，公司尚未交付商业化产品，收入验证缺失，估值远超收入基础。
